preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string N must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of lowercase English alphabets.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained from the input string S.
